entry.title: Remembered conflict no longer gets to knock by itself
entry.body: A Quiet Conflict Retention Envelope and fourteen-case deterministic suite separate returnable unresolved state from foreground authority. Retention keeps a canonical conflict pointer but no winner, precedence, or resolution. Session start, recency, and inferred relevance do not automatically resurface it. The replay passed 14/14. Product remains v0.1.0.

waitAMinute.summary: Selective Attention, TurtleAsk, Temporary Hold, and retained conflict repeat the same boundary: retrievable state does not automatically take the foreground.
